# Third-party notices

PL_MPEG retains MIT attribution in its source and PL_MPEG.md. citro2d/citro3d, LZ4, JPEG and zlib notices are included here. libmpg123 1.31.3 source is included as its upstream source archive with COPYING and AUTHORS; it retains its LGPL terms. devkitPro SDK/tools are not copied into this repository. Developer data in the owner-unlocked package includes the original application object files and SMDH for relinking; see release/relink.py. The SDK library hashes used for this build are recorded in sdk-libraries.json.

Upstream SDK sources: https://github.com/devkitPro/libctru , https://github.com/devkitPro/citro2d , https://github.com/devkitPro/citro3d . Compiler runtime: GCC Runtime Library Exception applies to the compiler runtime; see https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gcc-exception-3.1.html . Original Lume content is outside the project GPL license.

The setup homebrew uses tiny-AES-c (Unlicense) and PicoSHA2 (MIT). Complete vendored sources, licenses, immutable upstream URLs and SHA256 values are under installer/. minizip is linked from the SDK zlib port; the zlib notices apply.
